gdp_level.label: GDP, current prices, not seasonally adjusted (DOSM, OpenDOSM gdp_qtr_nominal)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, constant prices (DOSM, OpenDOSM gdp_qtr_real)

gdp_growth_yoy.label: Real GDP growth, change on same quarter a year earlier (DOSM, OpenDOSM gdp_qtr_real)

policy_rate.label: Overnight policy rate (BIS central bank policy rates, M.MY, from May 2004)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, change on previous quarter, seasonally adjusted, from DOSM's seasonally adjusted real GDP (OpenDOSM gdp_qtr_real_sa)

cpi.label: CPI, all items, YoY, as published (DOSM, OpenDOSM cpi_headline_inflation)

cpi_mom.label: CPI, all items, MoM, as published (DOSM, OpenDOSM cpi_headline_inflation)

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted (DOSM labour force survey, OpenDOSM lfs_month_sa)

participation.label: Labour force participation rate, seasonally adjusted (DOSM, OpenDOSM lfs_month_sa)

employment.label: Employment-to-population ratio, not seasonally adjusted (DOSM, OpenDOSM lfs_month)

exports.label: Exports of goods, FOB (DOSM external trade, OpenDOSM trade_sitc_1d)

imports.label: Imports of goods, CIF (DOSM external trade, OpenDOSM trade_sitc_1d)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports FOB less imports CIF (DOSM external trade)
